books.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
books.author: Martin Kleppmann
books.take: The book that should be issued to every backend developer on day one. I've read it twice and I'm still finding new things.

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.author: Andy Weir
books.take: Read it in one weekend. Made me believe in sci-fi again.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.take: Half of it is obvious. The other half is the half I needed.

books.title: The Pragmatic Programmer
books.author: Andy Hunt and Dave Thomas
books.take: Still holds up. The chapter on broken windows changed how I review code.

books.title: Sapiens
books.author: Yuval Noah Harari
books.take: Confidently wrong in places, but the parts that land hit hard.

books.title: The Mom Test
books.author: Rob Fitzpatrick
books.take: Short, brutal, and the only sales book I have ever finished. Useful for freelancing too.
